title: DiRGeo: Learning Directional Geometry of Visual Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.29057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional geometric measures of visual representations are symmetric, assigning equal costs to forward and reverse motion along the same path. We propose DiRGeo, a framework for learning directional geometry over frozen visual representations. Grounded in Randers geometry, DiRGeo learns a state-dependent directional field from ordered image trajectories through self-supervised contrast, without semantic labels. Sphere-tangent correction and attractor-relative decomposition distinguish learned directional structure from normalization artifacts and common convergence. Experiments across 17 visual processes, three encoder families, and multiple representation depths demonstrate consistent directional discrimination and whole-path asymmetry beyond simple attractor-based explanations. The learned fields become increasingly process-specific in deeper representations, while natural-video experiments reveal event-dependent directional prefere

translated_title: DiRGeo：学习视觉表示的方向性几何
translated_abstract: 传统上对视觉表示的几何度量是对称的，即沿同一路径的正向与反向运动被赋予相同的代价。我们提出DiRGeo，一个在冻结视觉表示上学习方向性几何的框架。DiRGeo植根于Randers几何，通过自监督对比从有序图像轨迹中学习状态依赖的方向场，且无需语义标签。球面切向修正与吸引子相对分解将学习到的方向结构与归一化伪影及共同收敛区分开来。在17个视觉过程、三种编码器家族以及多个表示深度上的实验表明，该框架具有一致的方向性判别能力，并展现出超越简单吸引子解释的整条路径不对称性。学习到的方向场在更深的表示层中变得越来越具有过程特异性，而自然视频实验则揭示了依赖事件的方向偏好。
tldr: 提出基于Randers几何的DiRGeo框架，无需语义标签即可从有序图像轨迹中自监督学习冻结视觉表示的方向性几何，揭示了传统对称几何度量无法捕捉的路径不对称性。
en_tdlr: DiRGeo, a Randers-geometry-based framework, learns directional geometry of frozen visual representations from ordered image trajectories via self-supervised contrast without semantic labels, revealing path asymmetry that conventional symmetric geometric measures cannot capture.
